Nasser Al-Qatami adhan (user-selected replacement):
Extracted without trimming from the MP4 supplied by the application owner:
أروع ما قد تسمعه في حياتك .. أذان من الشيخ ناصر القطامي [GN1f4LNoTUs].mp4
Converted to MP3 for browser compatibility. No voice synthesis or imitation was used. Replaces the previous Sajda recording. Attribution is based on the supplied file name; no independent rights license was supplied with the recording.

Audio revision 3 (2026-10-21): existing adhan recordings processed with a 65 Hz high-pass, mild adaptive FFT noise reduction (7 dB), 12 kHz low-pass and reduced gain; exported at 44.1 kHz / 128 kbps (Fajr: 64 kbps, 7.5 kHz low-pass; original was 16 kHz / 16 kbps mono). Original reciters and recording sources unchanged. Clean filenames end in -clean-v3.mp3. This reduces background noise; defects already embedded in the recording may remain.

Qatami revision 4 (2026-10-21): qatami-original-v4.ogg contains the original Opus audio packets remuxed directly from the owner-provided MP4 with ffmpeg -c:a copy. No denoiser, resampling, voice editing or lossy re-encoding. Full decoded content matches the uploaded audio exactly after accounting for a 24-sample (0.5 ms) container offset. Replaces the processed Qatami MP3 in revision 3; other recordings unchanged.
